Plan_of_Care.content: Start oral antihistamine such as Piriton or chlorphenamine 4 mg up to six times per day or a once-daily alternative
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Start oral antihistamine (e.g., Piriton/chlorphenamine 4mg up to 6x/day or once-daily alternative)

Plan_of_Care.content: Monitor for signs of systemic reaction including lip or tongue swelling, shortness of breath, or stridor and seek urgent care or A&E if these develop
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Monitor for signs of systemic reaction: lip/tongue swelling, SOB, stridor—seek urgent care/A&E if develops

Plan_of_Care.content: Watch for spreading redness, heat, or signs of infection at the sting site and consider antibiotics if this occurs

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide information on symptoms of anaphylaxis
